prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pour the colored silicone mixture from the test tube into the mold at the center of tray.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: tray
What the inspection checks: Check whether the mold at the center of tray contains uniformly mixed silicone mixture.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Overhead view of a square white plastic tray or open-topped enclosure with raised walls, sitting on a light grey work surface. The tray interior is empty apart from one small teal/green plastic block with four round studs on its upper face, resting flat near the centre. The floor of the tray shows eight recessed metal screw heads arranged around the middle, plus faint pink/red scuff marks and scratches. On the left outer wall are a piece of white tape near the top corner, a dark grey/black rectangular pad, and a black hexagonal piece. Small black tape markers lie on the surface along the bottom edge; another white part is partly visible at the right edge. No liquids or containers are visible.
observations: The tray is empty except for a plastic block, with no silicone mixture or container visible, indicating the pouring step did not occur or failed.
